_note: Template only. The authoritative release-manifest.json is generated by CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) at tag checkout, AFTER the release zip is built and checksummed. It is published ALONGSIDE the zip (not embedded in it), so its artifact_checksum field can record the real zip SHA-256 without a self-referential hash. This guarantees tag target commit == manifest commit == artifact source commit.
